Generated spec for policy-interrupts

Usage:
  zqk system policy-interrupts [command]

Available Commands:
  ack         Acknowledge a policy interrupt (or all pending with --all)
  pending     List unacknowledged policy interrupts

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk system policy-interrupts [command] --help" for more information about a command.
